title: Amlo eyes 200 in exam fraud probe
desc: The government has widened its local-government exam fraud probe, with the Anti-Money Laundering Office (Amlo) tracing the financial transactions of more than 200 people involved in the network.
title_cn: 反洗钱办公室扩大地方政府考试舞弊调查范围
summary_cn: 泰国政府继续扩大对地方政府公务员考试舞弊案的调查范围，反洗钱办公室（AMLO）正在追踪参与舞弊网络的200多人的资金交易记录和流向。此次调查涉及复杂的贿赂和作弊网络，预计还会有更多涉案人员被曝光和进一步的指控。
desc_original: The government has widened its local-government exam fraud probe, with the Anti-Money Laundering Office (Amlo) tracing the financial transactions of more than 200 people involved in the network.

title: Na Ladprao beer hall owner charged over fatal fire
desc: Police have charged the owner of Na Ladprao beer hall with six offences following a fire last month that killed 37 people and injured 77 others.
title_cn: 那拉迪路啤酒厅（Na Ladprao）火灾案 老板遭控告
summary_cn: 曼谷那拉迪路啤酒厅上月发生火灾事故造成37人丧生、77人受伤，这是泰国近年最严重的公共安全事故之一。警方已对酒厅业主提出6项刑事指控，涉及场所安全管理不当和过失致死等罪名。
desc_original: Police have charged the owner of Na Ladprao beer hall with six offences following a fire last month that killed 37 people and injured 77 others.

title: Hospital graft claims 'unproven'
desc: The Ministry of Public Health has rejected claims of widespread corruption involving health promotion and prevention funds at community hospitals.
title_cn: 公共卫生部驳斥医院腐败指控「无证据支撑」
summary_cn: 泰国公共卫生部门正式否认有关社区医院挪用健康促进与疾病防控资金存在普遍腐败行为的指控。部门认为相关说法缺乏证据支撑，强调所有资金使用都符合规范并接受政府部门和审计机构的监督。
desc_original: The Ministry of Public Health has rejected claims of widespread corruption involving health promotion and prevention funds at community hospitals.

title: Down with the death penalty?
desc: A series of grisly murders has reignited one of the country's most enduring and divisive public debates: whether the death penalty remains necessary to protect society or whether the justice system should instead focus on improving law enforcement, rehabilitation and post-release supervision.
title_cn: 死刑存留之争：泰国重启司法制度大辩论
summary_cn: 一系列恶性谋杀案在泰国重新燃起对死刑制度长期存在的争议。支持者认为死刑是保护社会的必需措施，反对者则呼吁将重点转向改进执法效能、罪犯改造项目和释放后的社区监管。这一议题在泰国社会持续引发分化讨论。
desc_original: A series of grisly murders has reignited one of the country's most enduring and divisive public debates: whether the death penalty remains necessary to protect society or whether the justice system should instead focus on improving law enforcement, rehabilitation and post-release supervision.

title: No signs of bullying: witness
desc: The public should avoid speculating that bullying had triggered the shooting at Debsirin Nonthaburi School in Nonthaburi's Bang Kruai district, says Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul.
title_cn: 德昔林北榄学校枪击案无欺凌迹象
summary_cn: 泰国北榄府邦割县的德昔林北榄学校发生枪击事件后引起社会关注。总理阿努廷·詹威拉古尔引用证人证词指出，事件中并无欺凌行为的证据。总理呼吁公众应避免盲目推测欺凌是诱发事件的原因，应等待进一步调查结果。
desc_original: The public should avoid speculating that bullying had triggered the shooting at Debsirin Nonthaburi School in Nonthaburi's Bang Kruai district, says Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul.

title: Govt speeds up rooftop solar scheme
desc: The government is stepping up work on a rooftop solar scheme aimed at promoting clean energy and reducing household electricity costs.
title_cn: 泰国加速屋顶太阳能推广计划
summary_cn: 泰国政府正在加速推进屋顶太阳能安装计划。这一举措旨在加大清洁可再生能源的推广力度，同时帮助普通家庭显著降低电费支出。通过鼓励居民安装屋顶太阳能系统，政府体现了在能源结构优化和可持续发展方面的坚定承诺，推动泰国朝向绿色能源转型。
desc_original: The government is stepping up work on a rooftop solar scheme aimed at promoting clean energy and reducing household electricity costs.

title: Court halts delay of Social Security poll
desc: The Central Administrative Court has ordered a temporary suspension of an announcement postponing the Social Security Board election, clearing the way for the poll to proceed until the court issues a final ruling.
title_cn: 法院禁止延期社会保障委员会选举
summary_cn: 泰国中央行政法院做出临时禁令，暂停关于推迟社会保障委员会选举的官方公告。这一司法裁决维护了选举的进行权，为社保委员会选举的如期顺利进行扫除了法律障碍。选举将在法院最终判决前继续推进，保护了民众的参与权和制度的正常运转。
desc_original: The Central Administrative Court has ordered a temporary suspension of an announcement postponing the Social Security Board election, clearing the way for the poll to proceed until the court issues a final ruling.

title: Court rules against embattled NBTC chief
desc: The Central Administrative Court has rejected a petition filed by National Broadcasting and Telecommunications Commission (NBTC) chairman Sarana Boonbaichaiyapruck seeking to overturn a ruling that found grounds for his removal, saying he had not yet suffered a legally actionable injury.
title_cn: 法院驳回 NBTC 主席诉讼请求
summary_cn: 泰国中央行政法院驳回了国家广播电信委员会（NBTC）主席 Sarana Boonbaichaiyapruck 的请愿。该主席曾试图推翻一项认定他应被撤职的裁定，但法院认为其尚未遭受法律上可追究的伤害，因此驳回了其上诉。

title: Thailand pitches new deals to slash US tariffs
desc: Thailand pitches new deals to slash US tariffs Legacy Thailand is preparing a fresh round of proposals in its ongoing tariff talks with the United States , aiming to bring down the current 12.5% levy imposed under Section 301 through wider trade and investment cooperation. Vice Minister of Commerce Kirida Bhaopichitr gave an update on the negotiations, explaining that Thailand has faced two allegations from Washington. The first is that Bangkok lacks safeguards against imports made using forced labour. The second is that state subsidies to private industry have caused production overcapacity. On the forced labour issue, Kirida said Thailand has already signed a trade agreement with the US that resolves the matter. In return, Washington has granted tariff exemptions on more than 2,000 Thai products, covering roughly 60% of the kingdom’s exports to the US. Thailand has also pushed back on the overcapacity claim. Studies carried out with relevant agencies found that capacity utilisation in the industries Washington flagged, including automobiles and parts, rubber, pharmaceuticals, and machinery and equipment, sits between 75% and 95%. That, Kirida said, undercuts the US argument

title: True tie-up with university expands AI healthcare
desc: True Corporation has signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) for academic cooperation with Thammasat University's Faculty of Medicine, Thammasat University Hospital, and EGG Digital to advance the use of artificial intelligence (AI) in healthcare.

title: Six years, six major shootings in Thailand
desc: Six years, six major shootings in Thailand Legacy The shooting at Debsirin Nonthaburi School on Friday, August 7, has renewed attention on a series of major shooting incidents across Thailand since 2020, spanning shopping centres, a childcare centre, schools and a Bangkok market. Seven people died in the Nonthaburi attack, including three teachers, three students and the student suspect. Another 15 people were injured, two of them seriously. title: Vietnam overtakes Thailand in flight capacity race
desc: Vietnam overtakes Thailand in flight capacity race Legacy Thailand has fallen to No.3 in Southeast Asia’s flight seat rankings for the second consecutive month, with Vietnam overtaking the kingdom on rising domestic demand. OAG’s August report found Vietnam’s flight capacity rose 10% year-on-year to 7.27 million seats, holding onto No.2 after first overtaking Thailand in July. Vietnam’s domestic capacity alone jumped 13.8% to more than 4.7 million seats. Thailand’s total capacity slipped 1.7% to 7.19 million seats, while Indonesia stayed at No.1 with 11 million seats, up 4.3%. Suvarnabhumi remained the region’s third-busiest airport with 3.22 million seats, up 1%, trailing Singapore’s Changi (3.64 million) and Jakarta (3.32 million). Don Mueang fared worse, dropping 7.5% to 1.52 million seats, as low-cost carriers based there, including Thai AirAsia, cut capacity by 23.4% to 1.44 million seats. Patsee Permvongsenee, executive director for Asean, South Asia and South Pacific at the Tourism Authority of Thailand, said the shift reflects Vietnam’s growing travel demand, multiple large airports, and bulk seat bookings and joint promotions

title: Harnessing the power of big data
desc: The cabinet passed a resolution on July 27 acknowledging a draft of efforts to drive data utilisation or the National Big Data Strategic Plan 2025-27, aiming to turn Thailand into a "data-driven nation".
title_cn: 泰国启动国家大数据战略，力争打造「数据驱动国家」
summary_cn: 泰国内阁于7月27日通过决议，正式启动「国家大数据战略计划2025-27」，推动数据在各行业的应用和共享利用。该计划旨在将泰国转变为「数据驱动型国家」，通过数据赋能提升政府治理效能、企业竞争力和经济发展动能。
desc_original: The cabinet passed a resolution on July 27 acknowledging a draft of efforts to drive data utilisation or the National Big Data Strategic Plan 2025-27, aiming to turn Thailand into a "data-driven nation".

title: Ex-aide's STO appointment draws ire
desc: Political activist Asst Prof Dr Tul Sittisomwong has criticised the appointment of a former close aide to former prime minister Yingluck Shinawatra as director of the Strategic Transformation Office (STO).
title_cn: 前总理助手出任战略转型办公室主任引发政治风波
summary_cn: 泰国政治人士图尔·西体松翁(Tul Sittisomwong)公开批评政府任命英拉(Yingluck Shinawatra)前总理的亲密助手担任战略转型办公室(STO)主任一职。此人事安排引发政治争议，被认为带有明显的政党倾斜意图，引起政治活动人士和舆论警惕。
desc_original: Political activist Asst Prof Dr Tul Sittisomwong has criticised the appointment of a former close aide to former prime minister Yingluck Shinawatra as director of the Strategic Transformation Office (STO).

title: Egg prices hit 2-year high as farm costs rise
desc: Egg prices have climbed to a two-year high of 4 baht each, driven by reduced supplies due to hot weather and high animal feed prices. Prices are expected to ease in October as climate conditions improve.
title_cn: 鸡蛋价格创两年新高，农场成本攀升
summary_cn: 泰国鸡蛋价格攀升至两年高位，零售价达每枚4泰铢。持续高温天气导致产蛋量下降，加之饲料成本上升，供应紧张推高价格。业界预计随着10月份气候改善，价格将逐步回落，但近期仍对消费者日常食品支出造成压力。
desc_original: Egg prices have climbed to a two-year high of 4 baht each, driven by reduced supplies due to hot weather and high animal feed prices. Prices are expected to ease in October as climate conditions improve.

title: Govt weighs 2nd phase of co-payment scheme
desc: The government will review its fiscal position before deciding whether to proceed with the second phase of the "Thais Help Thais Plus" co-payment scheme or revise its conditions.
title_cn: 政府评估「泰人助泰人Plus」医疗补助计划第二阶段
summary_cn: 泰国政府将根据当前财政状况重新评估，决定是否推进「泰人助泰人Plus」(Thais Help Thais Plus)医疗补助计划的第二阶段，或对计划条件进行必要调整。该计划旨在向低收入民众提供医疗补助支持，关系到普通民众医疗保障。
desc_original: The government will review its fiscal position before deciding whether to proceed with the second phase of the "Thais Help Thais Plus" co-payment scheme or revise its conditions.

title: Tax breaks to lure carmakers
desc: The Finance Ministry plans to introduce tax incentives by September to encourage foreign carmakers to establish production facilities in Thailand and increase the use of locally made components.
title_cn: 泰国推出税收优惠政策吸引外资车企投资建厂
summary_cn: 泰国财政部计划于9月前推出一系列税收激励措施，鼓励国际汽车制造商在泰建立生产设施并增加本地零部件采购比例。此举旨在强化泰国作为东南亚制造业枢纽的吸引力，推动汽车产业升级，创造就业机会并带动经济增长。
desc_original: The Finance Ministry plans to introduce tax incentives by September to encourage foreign carmakers to establish production facilities in Thailand and increase the use of locally made components.

title: New LPG subsidy strains fuel fund
desc: The Energy Ministry has announced an increase in the subsidy for liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) to keep domestic cooking gas prices unchanged, though the move adds financial pressure on the state Oil Fuel Fund.
title_cn: 液化石油气补贴增加 国家油气基金承压
summary_cn: 泰国能源部宣布增加对液化石油气(LPG)的补贴，旨在维持国内烹饪用气价格的稳定。这一措施有助于控制食品成本、保护普通民众的日常开支。然而，随着补贴幅度扩大，国家油气基金(Oil Fuel Fund)面临更大的财政压力。这种平衡物价稳定与财政可持续性的举措，反映了政府在经济管理中面临的两难困境。政策效果需持续评估。
desc_original: The Energy Ministry has announced an increase in the subsidy for liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) to keep domestic cooking gas prices unchanged, though the move adds financial pressure on the state Oil Fuel Fund.

title: Data centre growth meets resource limits
desc: Entrepreneurs are warning the rapid expansion of data centre investment could deepen water scarcity, even as they acknowledge its potential to drive business growth, according to the latest poll conducted by the Federation of Thai Industries (FTI).
title_cn: 数据中心扩张遭遇资源瓶颈
summary_cn: 根据泰国工业联合会(FTI)最新民调，企业界对数据中心投资快速扩张提出警告。数据中心产业虽具巨大经济增长潜力，能吸引外资、创造就业，但其对水资源的巨大需求成为主要隐忧。泰国本已面临水资源短缺，大规模扩张可能进一步加剧矛盾。如何在产业增长与资源保护间找到平衡，成为泰国产业政策的关键课题。这呼吁政策制定者采取前瞻性的规划措施。
desc_original: Entrepreneurs are warning the rapid expansion of data centre investment could deepen water scarcity, even as they acknowledge its potential to drive business growth, according to the latest poll conducted by the Federation of Thai Industries (FTI).

title: Massive flight cuts hit Thai regional status
desc: Thailand's regional ranking for airline seats fell to No.3 for the second consecutive month due to massive flight cuts, with Vietnam claiming No.2 as demand grows.
title_cn: 航班大幅减少 泰国区域地位下滑
summary_cn: 泰国在东南亚航空枢纽竞争中的地位下滑。受大规模航班削减影响，泰国区域航班座位数排名已跌至第3位，且连续两个月维持此排名。相比之下，越南凭借旅游需求增长推动，航班座位数排名上升至第2位，趋势明显向好。这一变化反映了泰国航空产业面临的压力，对旅游业和相关产业复苏产生负面影响，引发业界和政策层的广泛关注。
desc_original: Thailand's regional ranking for airline seats fell to No.3 for the second consecutive month due to massive flight cuts, with Vietnam claiming No.2 as demand grows.

title: สืบสานพระราชปณิธาน “สมเด็จพระบรมราชชนนีพันปีหลวง” “ไอคอนสยาม” ร่วมอนุรักษ์ศิลปหัตถกรรมไทย

title_cn: 暹罗图标继承王妃遗志 弘扬泰国传统工艺
summary_cn: Icon Siam(暹罗图标)商业综合体通过组织特色活动向故世泰国王妃诗琳通(Sirikit)致敬，继承其在传统工艺保护方面的遗志。该项目在商业空间内打造多处文化展示和体验区域，积极推广泰国传统手工艺的传承与发展。通过融合商业运营与文化保护，为工匠和手工艺品提供展示平台，为传统工艺的现代化传承做出有益尝试，体现对泰国文化遗产的尊重。

title_cn: 北榄府(Nonthaburi)学校枪击事件后宣布停课
summary_cn: 泰国北榄府Thepsirin学校在校园内发生严重枪击事件后，宣布全校各年级停课。停课时间为2026年8月10-14日(共5天)，涉及所有在校学生。此举是学校为确保学生和教职员生命安全而采取的紧急决定。该事件反映了泰国部分地区存在的安全隐忧，对学校教学秩序和学生家长造成直接影响，有待警方与相关部门的进一步跟进处理。

title: Central Retail to acquire MaxValu Thailand
desc: Central Retail Corporation Plc (CRC) has agreed to acquire AEON (Thailand) Co Ltd, the operator of 30 MaxValu supermarkets in Thailand, in a move aimed at strengthening its food retail business and expanding the footprint of its Tops supermarket chain.
title_cn: Central Retail 收购泰国 MaxValu 超市
summary_cn: 泰国零售巨头 Central Retail Corporation (CRC) 正式宣布收购 AEON (Thailand) 公司旗下全部 30 家 MaxValu 超市连锁。这项战略性并购旨在进一步强化 CRC 的食品零售业务能力，加快其旗下 Tops 超市品牌的市场扩张步伐，巩固其在泰国零售市场的领先地位。
desc_original: Central Retail Corporation Plc (CRC) has agreed to acquire AEON (Thailand) Co Ltd, the operator of 30 MaxValu supermarkets in Thailand, in a move aimed at strengthening its food retail business and expanding the footprint of its Tops supermarket chain.

summary_cn: 泰国 Nonthaburi 省一所学校发生重大校园枪击事件，造成 6 人不幸丧生。受害者遗体已被送往警察医院进行法医检验和确认身份。另有两位老年受害者（祖父母）的遗体预计稍后也将送达。这起事件引发社会广泛关注，反映出泰国校园安全防范的重要性。

title_cn: 校园枪击案遇难教师妹妹讲述噩耗时刻 3 个孩子仍不知父亲离世
summary_cn: 在 Nonthaburi 校园枪击事件中不幸遇难的教师其妹妹讲述了得知噩耗的那一刻，情绪悲痛。受害者遗下的 3 个孩子在事发现场见到遗体时仍不知道父亲已经离世，仍然向父亲做出胜利手势，场面令人心碎。遗属已与法医部门联系，积极准备后续的丧葬安排和悼念仪式。

summary_cn: 泰国防灾指挥部召开会议应对南部地区日益严峻的洪灾和干旱威胁。会议提出建立「邻里互助」(Big Brother/Sister House) 防灾模式，加强社区防灾能力，同时建立 SMS 预警系统确保及时警报。政府强调将优先帮助老弱病残、低收入等弱势群体度过灾难，确保人道主义援助到位。

title: Married Thai woman seeks protection after affair turns into year of abuse
desc: Married Thai woman seeks protection after affair turns into year of abuse Legacy A married Thai woman from Lamphun province sought government assistance after she endured a year of blackmail , threats and intimidation by her affair partner . The woman, accompanied by her husband, met Thanakrit Jitareerak, assistant to the deputy prime minister, yesterday, August 6, to request protection. She said the relationship began in February last year and that her husband had been aware of it and accepted the situation. According to the woman, the pair initially met online before the man became increasingly controlling. She alleged he demanded regular updates on her daily activities and required her to send photographs throughout the day. She further claimed his behaviour escalated when he created a fake social media account using her identity and posted intimate images while falsely claiming she offered sexual services . title: Bullying emerges as possible motive in Nonthaburi school shooting
desc: Bullying emerges as possible motive in Nonthaburi school shooting Legacy Police are examining reports that the student responsible for the school shooting in Nonthaburi today, August 7, had been regularly bullied by classmates and had developed resentment over his treatment. In the latest report, eight people have now been confirmed dead, including five teachers, the student responsible for the shooting and his two grandparents , who police found dead at their home. One of the teachers killed was a deputy school director. Another 22 people were injured and are being treated. Nine are seriously injured, including seven students and two teachers. Hone Krasae host Kanchai Kamnerdploy reported that the student first shot a teacher in his own classroom before moving to a neighbouring classroom, where he shot two more teachers and injured students. title: Thai MP removed over peace chants at Min Aung Hlaing reception
desc: Thai MP removed over peace chants at Min Aung Hlaing reception Legacy A People’s Party MP was removed from a reception area at Parliament today, August 7, after repeatedly calling for peace and humanity as Myanmar Senior General Min Aung Hlaing arrived for an official reception. The incident occurred as Senate President Mongkol Surasajja was scheduled to receive Min Aung Hlaing, who is visiting Thailand as a guest of the government. Before the reception began, Bangkok MP Anusorn Tamajai of the People’s Party waited outside the reception room to observe proceedings. title: Every property type in Thailand real estate, explained
desc: Every property type in Thailand real estate, explained Legacy Ask five foreign buyers what buying real estate or property in Thailand means, and you will get five different answers. One means a condo in Bangkok, another means a beach villa in Phuket , and a third means a plot of raw land they plan to build on themselves. There are two questions to separate before anything else: what kind of property is it, and what ownership structure applies to it. Get those two questions backwards, and you can end up negotiating hard on a villa you were never going to own outright anyway. This guide runs through every major property type in Thailand real estate, what it typically costs, and whether a foreigner can own it. desc: Protesters oppose Thai engagement with Min Aung Hlaing Legacy The Bright Future group , migrant worker networks and Thai citizens gathered outside the United Nations office in Thailand yesterday, August 6, to protest the Thai government’s reception of Myanmar Senior General Min Aung Hlaing and representatives of the State Administration Council (SAC). title: Car crashes into Kanchanaburi childcare centre, 15 children injured
desc: Car crashes into Kanchanaburi childcare centre, 15 children injured Legacy Fifteen children were injured after a car crashed into a childcare development centre in Kanchanaburi today, August 7. All of the injured children were taken to hospital and are reported to be safe . The Rattanavudh Foundation reported that the car crashed into Ban Nong Song Ton Child Development Centre in Mueang district, prompting rescue workers, emergency medical teams and police to respond. A teacher said 34 children were at the centre today. Fifteen were injured and taken to hospital, while the remaining 19 were unharmed. Photo via Rattanavudh Foundation Emergency workers assessed the injured and provided first aid at the scene before transferring them to hospital. Traffic around the area was managed to allow ambulances and rescue vehicles to reach the centre. The Rattanavudh Foundation asked motorists to give way to emergency vehicles and follow instructions from officials. The cause of the crash has not yet been disclosed, with further details expected following an investigation. title: 泰国一轿车失控撞入幼儿中心，14名午睡儿童受伤
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 8月7日，泰国北碧府发生一起轿车失控冲撞幼儿中心事件。事发时，弄松吞乡镇行政组织幼儿发展中心的儿童正在午睡，车辆撞破围墙，飞溅的水泥碎块和混凝土碎片造成14名儿童受伤，伤情包括头部破裂、嘴唇破裂及身体多处淤伤。工作人员已紧急将伤者送医。 当天12时52分，北碧府皮塔护北碧基金会志愿人员出动10余辆救护车，将勐县该幼儿发展中心的受伤学童转运至帕洪蓬帕育哈社纳医院。事发时，孩子们刚用完午餐，正在午休，保育老师在旁看护。事故发生后，老师迅速将儿童带离受损房间，并协调救援人员到场施救。 涉事轿车司机及同车乘客（两人为亲属关系）受轻伤，同样被送往上述医院接受检查治疗。据初步调查，事发前司机因既往病史发作，在驾车经过幼儿中心后方道路时突然昏厥，导致车辆失控撞向建筑后墙，该位置恰好正对儿童午睡房间，从而酿成事故。 目前，工作人员正进一步核查事故确切原因，评估建筑损毁情况，并持续密切跟进所有受伤儿童的伤情。 （编译：Wan；来源：Dailynews） The post 泰国一轿车失控撞入幼儿中心，14名午睡儿童受伤 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: Are Thailand’s gun laws outdated in 2026
desc: Are Thailand’s gun laws outdated in 2026 Legacy Thailand has one of the highest rates of civilian gun ownership in Southeast Asia. Estimates put the number of civilian gun owners at more than 10.34 million, while only around 6.22 million guns are legally registered. That gap between registered and unregistered firearms is one of the defining features of Thailand’s gun culture, and it sits at the centre of an ongoing debate about where the law goes next. Are guns legal in Thailand? Yes, but within a structured legal framework that has been tightening since 2023. The primary legislation is the Firearms, Ammunition, Explosives and Fireworks Act, which governs the purchase, possession, carrying, and use of firearms by civilians. Under this framework, Thai nationals aged 20 and above can apply for a firearms licence through the district office, provided they pass a background check, have no prior criminal convictions, and can demonstrate a legitimate reason for ownership, typically self-defence, sport shooting, or occupational necessity. title: 中国游客格兰岛骑摩托坠崖，一死一伤！
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 据泰国媒体报道，8月7日，泰国春武里府芭提雅格兰岛发生一起摩托车坠崖事故，一名中国籍男游客当场死亡，其女儿受伤送医，当地警方正积极调查事故原因。 据悉，事故发生在格兰岛风车观景点下山路段。当地救援中心接到求救电话称，一辆摩托车在下坡时失控冲出弯道，坠落悬崖，救援人员随即赶赴现场。 事故现场发现一辆登记于曼谷的本田Click125摩托车以及一名男性死者，经确认死者为Wan Xuechun，51岁，中国籍。此外，现场还有一名约30岁的中国籍女子受伤，经确认系死者女儿。救援人员对其进行了现场急救，随后送往格兰岛医院接受进一步治疗。 警方初步调查显示，父女二人在上岛后租赁摩托车前往风车观景点游览，返程下山时车辆失控冲出弯道坠崖，导致父亲当场身亡，女儿受伤。 目前，当地警方正进一步调查事故具体原因。死者遗体已送往医院暂存，等待家属办理认领及后续事宜。 （编译：jinda；审校：wan；来源：khaosod） The post 中国游客格兰岛骑摩托坠崖，一死一伤！ appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: 泰国校园枪击案枪手疑先杀害爷爷奶奶，再赴学校开枪
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 据泰媒报道，8月7日，泰国暖武里府Debsirin Nonthaburi学校内发生枪击事件。此前报道称，该事件已造成15人受伤、7人死亡，其中包括使用手枪自伤的学生嫌疑人，该嫌疑人在送医途中不治身亡。 事件发生后，泰国国家警察总署副署长萨兰等人先后赶赴现场，指挥调查并搜集证据，同时对目击者进行问询，重点追查涉案枪支来源及嫌疑人作案动机，以尽快查明事件真相。 最新消息显示，暖武里府警方调查组随后前往嫌疑人位于Bang Bua Thong地区Wat Lat Pla Duk巷内的住所展开进一步调查，以深入排查案件原因及动机。 调查人员在住所内发现另外2具尸体，死者为嫌疑人的爷爷和奶奶，均因头部中弹身亡。据初步了解，嫌疑人一直与爷爷奶奶共同生活，其父母则在他年幼时便已离异。 目前，警方正持续深入调查，并将适时公布案件最新进展。 （编译：Wan；来源：Thairath） The post 泰国校园枪击案枪手疑先杀害爷爷奶奶，再赴学校开枪 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: 泰国一学校发生枪击事件，已致2名教师死亡、约20人受伤
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 据泰媒报道，8月7日，暖武里府Debsirin学校校内发生一起枪击事件，引发校内教师、学生及工作人员的广泛恐慌。 事发后，当地警方、救援人员及紧急医疗队迅速赶赴现场，全力控制局势，并对校内受伤人员展开紧急救助。 初步消息显示，枪击已造成约15至20人受伤，其中3人伤势严重，均为胸部中弹。目前，工作人员已封锁事发区域周边，以确保现场安全，并加紧勘查取证，全力追查涉案人员。同时，校方已组织学生、教师及工作人员有序撤离危险区域。相关部门也已协调其他单位，共同参与救援与处置工作。 初步调查显示，涉案嫌疑人为一名未成年人，警方正就案件细节展开进一步调查。 最新消息称，事件中已有2人死亡，据悉均为该校教师。 （编译：Wan；来源：Khaosod） The post 泰国一学校发生枪击事件，已致2名教师死亡、约20人受伤 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: 泰国逮捕一名中国通缉犯，涉案金额达3500万
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 8月7日，泰国移民局副局长普拉亚警少将、移民局第一分局局长帕萨警少将在接获中国驻泰国大使馆及国家警察总署的通报名单后，联合发起代号为“一个不留”的专项行动，旨在扫荡外籍犯罪分子。近日，调查人员深入一线进行排查，成功逮捕了47岁的中国籍女嫌疑人“那加”（Mrs. NAJIA，音译），其涉嫌在中国上海伪造发票，虚开骗税，被中国警方通缉，总涉案金额达3500万人民币（折合泰铢约2亿）。 但该嫌疑人在案发后逃至泰国藏匿，且为躲避追查频繁更换住处、发型、着装及职业。她还试图打造商人形象，混迹于尖竹汶府的榴莲园圈子，并在尖竹汶府与曼谷之间往返，声称要将榴莲引入曼谷市场销售。同时，该嫌疑人在曼谷及巴吞他尼府Thai集市周边租了多个住处，以增加警方的追踪难度。 调查人员经持续跟踪和分析“那加”的行动路线，最终在巴吞他尼府Khlong Luang县Khlong Nueng镇Thai集市附近的一处住宅附近将其控制。目前，嫌疑人“那加”已被移交至移民局第三分局，依法进一步处理。普拉亚警少将表示，移民局将继续推进跨国犯罪打击工作，全力维护国家安全与公众安全，决不允许泰国以任何形式成为跨国犯罪分子的藏身之所。 （编译：KA；来源：voicetv） The post 泰国逮捕一名中国通缉犯，涉案金额达3500万 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: 泰缅发表联合声明，全方位合作促进区域和平
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 8月6日，泰国外交部表示，缅甸总统敏昂莱于8月6日至7日对泰国展开正式访问，期间，泰国总理兼内政部部长阿努廷与其签署了联合声明，旨在巩固和深化两国在政治与安全、经济、环境、社会与文化等多个领域的区域合作。 在政治与安全方面，双方一致同意推动高层互访及各层级的对话交流，尽早举行泰国-缅甸双边合作联合委员会（JC）会议。另外，两国将共同升级预防和打击跨国犯罪方面的合作，特别是网络诈骗和毒品问题，加强有关部门之间的协调，包括共享信息情报，采取联合行动打击泰缅边境的网络诈骗，切断跨国犯罪网络的资金链。在经济合作方面，双方重申将致力于促进和提供双边贸易便利，以实现双边贸易额达到120亿美元的目标。 两国领导人对泰缅第二跨国友谊大桥永久边境口岸的重新开放表示欢迎，该口岸在两国边境贸易中发挥着重要的作用。后续还将根据双方意愿和安全局势考虑开放更多边境口岸，以进一步促进边境贸易和两国间的互联互通。 鉴于能源安全的战略重要性，两国确认将加深能源领域的合作，特别是天然气资源的开发，确保两国拥有稳定可靠的能源来源。与此同时，双方均对新版泰缅劳务合作谅解备忘录（MOU）及就业协议表示欢迎。 在环境合作方面，双方确认将一起应对环境挑战，包括跨境雾霾、露天焚烧和水污染问题，例如开发森林火灾监测与预警系统和持续开展森林火灾预防合作等。针对缅甸矿山有毒物质污染泰国多条河流的问题，两国已签署了《泰缅边境与界河水质管理联合工作组职责范围文件》，相关部门将在水质管理方面保持密切联系，并尽早召开联合工作组会议。 在社会与文化合作方面，泰国和缅甸共同强调了民间交流的重要性，同意加强两国旅游部门间的合作。 在区域合作方面，泰缅领导人一致赞同在包括东盟（ASEAN）、环孟加拉湾多领域经济技术合作倡议（BIMSTEC）、伊洛瓦底江-湄南河-湄公河经济合作战略（ACMECS）以及各项大湄公河次区域合作框架内相互支持，促进区域的和平、稳定、可持续发展与繁荣。 泰国政府重申，泰国将全力支持缅甸担任ACMECS轮值主席国，并与缅甸保持密切合作，根据《东盟宪章》、相关原则及程序，促进缅甸全面、平等地参与东盟的各项机制。缅方对泰国在推动缅甸与东盟关系恢复正常化方面发挥的建设性作用表示感谢，同时，泰国赞赏缅甸持续推进和平谈判，通过“缅甸所有、缅甸主导”进程实现持久和平。 （编译：KA；来源：thestandard） The post 泰缅发表联合声明，全方位合作促进区域和平 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .
title_cn: 泰缅领导人签署联合声明，深化全方位战略合作

title: 又一泰中新航线9月开通，助力泰国打造世界航空枢纽
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 8月6日，泰国交通部副部长帕塔拉蓬透露，交通部正在推进航空基础设施升级，同时引入数字技术改善空中交通管理，以提高安全性、减少航班延误，并支持环保飞行。他已指示航空广播有限公司加快与气象局合作的气象雷达数据整合项目，让空中交通管制人员能使用更准确、更实时的气象信息管理航班，特别是在天气多变的时候，提升空中交通管理效率。 此外，交通部还在推动全系统信息管理（SWIM）的开发，以按国际民航组织标准（ICAO）进行数字化飞行信息交换，并设定目标让航空广播有限公司在2030年前成为SWIM服务提供商，这是泰国向新一代飞行信息管理系统转型的重要一步。与此同时，加速与民航局的整合工作，确保泰国能按时全面对接全球航空系统，把泰国打造成世界级航空枢纽。 航空广播有限公司董事长披切表示，据评估，2026财年（2025年10月至2026年9月）的总航班数将达到919,643架次，日均2,520架次，比2025财年增长1.64%；截至目前的航班数已有777,456架次，日均2,558架次，包括国际航班385,991架次、国内航班297,234架次、过境航班94,231架次。尽管中东冲突影响了增长，但该数量仍符合预期，反映出泰国航空业持续复苏并稳定增长的趋势。 进出和过境泰国航班数最高的国家分别是中国、印度、马来西亚、新加坡和越南；航班最密集的机场依次为素万那普、廊曼、普吉、清迈和苏梅。2026年9月3日，L770（NAN–SAGAG）航线即将启用，这是一条从泰国直达中国的航线，由泰国、中国和老挝合作开通，可缩短飞行距离27.5至35.2海里，进一步提高了空中交通管理效率，并降低航空公司成本，节省燃油，减少温室气体排放，为东南亚和中国之间的出行增长提供了有力支持。 （编译：KA；来源：thairath） The post 又一泰中新航线9月开通，助力泰国打造世界航空枢纽 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .
title_cn: 泰中新航线9月启用，优化东南亚至华空中运输
summary_cn: 泰国交通部推进航空基础设施现代化升级。L770新航线将于9月3日启用，连接泰国南邦Nan与中国广东，由泰中老三国合作开通。该航线可缩短飞行距离27.5-35.2海里，提高空中交通管制效率，减少航空公司成本和燃油消耗，有力支持东南亚与中国间航空运输增长和低碳飞行。

title: Tiger attack sparks safety review
desc: The tragic death of a forest ranger at the jaws of a tiger has prompted grief and difficult questions. Was this an isolated incident, or a warning sign of a growing overlap between humans and Thailand's recovering tiger population? This explainer explores the latest findings, the behaviour of wild tigers and the measures being taken to prevent such a tragedy from happening again.
title_cn: 护林员遭虎咬身亡引发安全审查
summary_cn: 一名护林员被老虎咬死，引发对人类与泰国虎群活动重叠加剧的深层思考。当局启动安全评估，深入研究野生虎习性和人兽冲突成因，制定防范措施以防止类似悲剧再度发生。事件背后反映泰国虎保护成果与安全风险间的矛盾。
desc_original: The tragic death of a forest ranger at the jaws of a tiger has prompted grief and difficult questions. Was this an isolated incident, or a warning sign of a growing overlap between humans and Thailand's recovering tiger population? This explainer explores the latest findings, the behaviour of wild tigers and the measures being taken to prevent such a tragedy from happening again.

title: Senator urges dissolution of NBTC board
desc: Senator Premsak Piayura has urged Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul to dissolve the entire National Broadcasting and Telecommunications Commission (NBTC) board and restart the selection process.

summary_cn: 参议员普雷姆萨克（Premsak Piayura）敦促总理阿努廷（Anutin Charnvirakul）解散国家广播电信委员会（NBTC）所有董事，并重新启动选拔程序。此举反映对该机构治理结构和决策过程的关切和质疑。
desc_original: Senator Premsak Piayura has urged Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul to dissolve the entire National Broadcasting and Telecommunications Commission (NBTC) board and restart the selection process.

title: Roojai reveals plans to diversify for 2030
desc: Online insurer Roojai has unveiled an ambitious growth strategy for 2030, betting on artificial intelligence (AI), new health insurance products and regional expansion to strengthen its position in Thailand's increasingly competitive insurance market.
title_cn: 线上保险商Roojai发布2030年多元化战略
summary_cn: 线上保险公司Roojai宣布2030年发展规划，将重点投资人工智能技术、开发新型健康保险产品、拓展地区市场份额，以强化其在泰国竞争激烈的保险行业中的地位。
desc_original: Online insurer Roojai has unveiled an ambitious growth strategy for 2030, betting on artificial intelligence (AI), new health insurance products and regional expansion to strengthen its position in Thailand's increasingly competitive insurance market.

title: StanChart sees weak baht for rest of 2026
desc: Standard Chartered Bank (Thai) expects the baht to remain weak for the rest of the year, despite its recent appreciation this week driven by external factors.

summary_cn: 渣打银行（泰国）预计泰铢在2026年余下时间内将保持疲软趋势，尽管本周受外部因素推动略有升值。这一预期对有外币资产、海外留学或跨境汇兑需求的人士具有参考意义。
desc_original: Standard Chartered Bank (Thai) expects the baht to remain weak for the rest of the year, despite its recent appreciation this week driven by external factors.

title: CIMBT calls for sustainable data centre investment
desc: CIMB Thai Bank (CIMBT) has urged policymakers to prioritise sustainable investment in data centre projects to maximise the long-term benefits for the Thai economy.
title_cn: 泰国中华银行呼吁优先投资可持续数据中心
summary_cn: 泰国中华银行（CIMB Thai）敦促政策制定者优先考虑对数据中心项目的可持续投资，以最大化对泰国经济的长期效益。
desc_original: CIMB Thai Bank (CIMBT) has urged policymakers to prioritise sustainable investment in data centre projects to maximise the long-term benefits for the Thai economy.

title: Myanmar targets growth in trade

summary_cn: 泰国与缅甸承诺深化经济合作，重启主要贸易路线并加快投资步伐，力争将双边贸易提升至120亿美元（约3970亿泰铢）。
desc_original: Thailand and Myanmar have pledged to deepen economic cooperation, reopen key trade routes and accelerate investment as both countries seek to raise bilateral trade to US$12 billion (397 billion baht).

title: El Niño effect may result in rice exports of 7m tonnes
desc: The El Niño phenomenon is expected to help Thailand achieve its rice export goal of 7 million tonnes this year, according to a shipper.
title_cn: 厄尔尼诺效应或助泰国水稻出口达700万吨
summary_cn: 根据出口商预测，厄尔尼诺（El Niño）现象预计将帮助泰国实现今年700万吨的水稻出口目标。
desc_original: The El Niño phenomenon is expected to help Thailand achieve its rice export goal of 7 million tonnes this year, according to a shipper.

desc_original: Thailand and Myanmar signed three memoranda of understanding (MoUs) on Thursday aimed at deepening bilateral cooperation in labour, transboundary water quality management and space technology.

desc_original: Thailand aims to secure Unesco Creative Cities Network (UCCN) recognition for two new destinations every two years as part of a national strategy to have at least 35 Thai cities designated by 2037, according to the Designated Areas for Sustainable Tourism Administration (Dasta).

title: Tiger that killed ranger was juvenile, not a man-eater
desc: The tiger that killed a wildlife ranger in Huai Kha Khaeng Wildlife Sanctuary was not fully grown, still learning to hunt and failed to meet the definition of a "man-eater", the Department of National Parks, Wildlife and Plant Conservation (DNP) said on Thursday.
title_cn: 击杀护林员的老虎为幼虎 非「食人虎」
summary_cn: 泰国国家公园、野生动物及植物保护部（DNP）表示，在怀卡开 Huai Kha Khaeng 野生动物保护区杀死一名护林员的老虎为未成年幼虎，当时正在学习狩猎技能，其行为并不符合「食人虎」的定义。此结论有助澄清该事件的性质。
desc_original: The tiger that killed a wildlife ranger in Huai Kha Khaeng Wildlife Sanctuary was not fully grown, still learning to hunt and failed to meet the definition of a "man-eater", the Department of National Parks, Wildlife and Plant Conservation (DNP) said on Thursday.

title: Chon Buri burial site scan finds no additional bodies
desc: CHON BURI: An extensive search of a coconut plantation in Bang Lamung district linked to the high-profile murder of two Russian siblings and a Thai family of three has turned up no additional bodies, according to police.
title_cn: 春武里（Chon Buri）埋藏地点搜索未发现追加尸体
summary_cn: 春武里（Chon Buri）邦腊蒙县（Bang Lamung）一处椰子园进行了广泛搜索。该地点与俄罗斯兄妹及泰国三人家庭遭谋杀案有关。据警方称，搜索结果未发现任何追加尸体。
desc_original: CHON BURI: An extensive search of a coconut plantation in Bang Lamung district linked to the high-profile murder of two Russian siblings and a Thai family of three has turned up no additional bodies, according to police.

title: Songkhla officer accused of sexual exploitation surrenders
desc: The police officer in Songkhla province accused of forcing women to record pornographic content, with some allegedly coerced to avoid criminal charges, surrendered at Thung Lung police station on Wednesday night.
title_cn: 宋卡（Songkhla）警官因性剥削罪指控投案
summary_cn: 涂龙警局（Thung Lung）一名宋卡（Songkhla）警官周三晚间投案自首。该警官被控强迫妇女录制色情内容，部分受害者遭威胁以逃避刑事指控。涉及严重的性剥削和刑事强制罪行。
desc_original: The police officer in Songkhla province accused of forcing women to record pornographic content, with some allegedly coerced to avoid criminal charges, surrendered at Thung Lung police station on Wednesday night.

title: Ex-department chief faces six charges in recruitment exam fraud probe

title_cn: 前地方行政部总监因招聘考试舞弊案被控六项重罪
summary_cn: 打击犯罪部（CSD）对Theerut Suphawiboonphol（前地方行政部DLA总监）提出六项严重指控，涉及地方政府招聘考试舞弊案。该案件反映泰国公务员招聘制度中存在的腐败问题，引发公众关注。
desc_original: The Crime Suppression Division (CSD) has filed six serious charges against Theerut Suphawiboonphol, former director-general of the Department of Local Administration (DLA), over his alleged role in a local government recruitment exam fraud.

title: Heart failure may have killed Hlun Solo, poisoning not ruled out
desc: The Central Institute of Forensic Science (CIFS), under the Justice Ministry, conducted an autopsy on the body of popular travel YouTuber Hlun Solo on Thursday and found that heart failure could be a cause while poison has not been ruled out.
title_cn: 旅游YouTuber Hlun Solo 可能因心脏衰竭身亡，中毒未排除

title: 泰国数据中心投资聚焦资源保障 拟实施差别化水电价政策
desc: 泰国头条新闻社 据泰媒报道，8月6日，泰国内阁近日批准了《总理府办公室关于数据中心业务政策委员会的条例》草案。泰国投资促进委员会（BOI）表示，将据此重新审查数据中心项目投资优惠政策框架，回应社会对能源、水资源和环境影响的关切。 BOI数据显示，2024年至2026年期间，已批准42个数据中心投资项目，总投资额约7500亿泰铢。 在内阁8月5日批准《总理府办公室关于数据中心业务政策委员会的条例》草案后，泰国将成立国家级数据中心政策委员会，由副总理担任主席，负责统筹数字基础设施发展。 BOI秘书长纳立表示，BOI将全面重新评估数据中心项目的投资促进政策，提高项目审查标准，使其符合新成立的数据中心政策委员会的指导方针，确保项目能够为国家创造更大价值，同时减少对能源、水资源、环境及社区的影响。 他表示，泰国面临的课题不是在全面拒绝数据中心投资和毫无限制接受所有项目之间二选一，而是要思考泰国真正需要什么样的数据中心，并共同制定规则，使国家和人民获得最大利益。 为回应社会各界关切，BOI董事会在副总理艾卡尼的领导下，提出从四个方面加强数据中心项目审查，并据此决定是否给予投资优惠。包括要求企业创造高技能就业岗位、开展技术转移，并与高校合作培养本土工程师。例如，AWS与泰王科技学院合作开设数据中心工程专业课程，谷歌则实施“Samart Skills”人才培养计划。 同时，鼓励企业优先采购本土供应链产品，推动泰国本地供应商和中小企业进入数据中心产业链。 此外，还要求数据中心向泰国初创企业、高校及中小企业开放算力资源，并提供价格合理的云计算服务，推动本国人工智能生态发展。 BOI支持国家能源政策委员会提出的措施，将数据中心单独列为特殊用电类别，执行高于其他行业的电价，以反映电网扩容成本。同时，要求投资者提交用电履约保证金（Bank Guarantee），筛选具备真实投资能力的企业，并强制执行绿色数据中心标准及电能使用效率（PUE）指标。 BOI建议对数据中心实施较高的工业用水价格，并要求企业完善冷却系统、水资源循环利用及节水措施，确保旱季期间不会影响农业生产和社区居民用水。 政府将制定数据中心选址分区制度，并加快编制全国电力资源地图和水资源地图，预防火灾、噪声污染、热污染及污水排放等问题。 BOI表示，目前泰国正逐步成为全球数据中心关键设备的重要制造基地。目前，希捷（Seagate）和西部数据（Western Digital）在泰国生产硬盘驱动器；英业达（Inventec）和QMB生产人工智能服务器；InnoLight、Celestica和Fabrinet生产高速光通信设备；达尔塔电子（Delta）则生产数据中心冷却系统。下一阶段，BOI将推动这些设备在泰国本地实现采购和配套，减少“出口组装后再进口”的模式，进一步提高本地产业附加值和经济乘数效应。 针对社会关注的数据中心投资

title: 泰国机场10月接轨国际 托运行李发现可疑物品可不开箱通知直接检查
desc: 泰国头条新闻社 据泰媒报道，8月6日，泰国民航局就《2026年托运行李航空运输安全检查公告》作出说明。该公告将于10月16日正式生效。 泰国民航局表示，新措施旨在进一步提升航空安全水平，使泰国航空安保制度与国际标准及全球多个国家和地区的通行做法接轨。同时强调，托运行李只有在存在合理怀疑的情况下才会被开箱检查，并非对所有旅客行李进行检查。 此前，泰国民航局已修订航空安全相关法规，以适应航空旅客数量持续增长，并提升安检效率。相关公告已于2026年2月发布，其中有关托运行李检查的新规定将于2026年10月16日正式实施，以便机场、航空公司及相关单位提前做好人员培训、系统建设及旅客宣传等准备工作。 民航局进一步解释，未经事先通知旅客开箱检查托运行李，仅适用于X光安检设备发现可疑物品或可能危及航空安全的物品时，并非针对普通旅客。 所有开箱检查均须在指定区域进行，全程实行影像记录并保存证据，确保事后可追溯，包括记录检查人员身份、检查发现的物品等信息。完成检查后，相关部门还须按照规定通知旅客，其托运行李已被开箱检查。 民航局指出，这一做法已是国际通行的航空安保标准，目前新加坡、日本、韩国以及中东、欧洲多个国家和美国均已实施类似措施，目的是防止危险物品被带上飞机，同时提高航班运行效率，减少因等待旅客到场开箱而导致的航班延误。 为方便旅客，民航局建议使用符合国际标准的行李锁，如TSA海关锁。如确有必要，安检人员可使用专用工具开启此类锁具，而不会损坏行李箱。 此外，旅客出行前应提前了解禁止携带物品及可能需要重点检查的物品清单。由于类似措施已在全球众多机场实施，旅客的行李在始发地、中转地或目的地均可能接受进一步检查。如携带违反当地法律法规的物品，可能影响正常出行。 如旅客因上述措施遇到问题或行李受到损坏，可向所乘航空公司提出投诉，也可通过泰国民航局投诉系统提交申诉，民航局将依法核查事实并按程序处理。 （编译：hansa ；审核：wan；来源：matichon） The post 泰国机场10月接轨国际 托运行李发现可疑物品可不开箱通知直接检查 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: Foreigner’s spirit house snack stop amuses, divides Thai netizens
desc: Foreigner’s spirit house snack stop amuses, divides Thai netizens Legacy A foreign man was caught on CCTV footage taking food and drink offerings from a spirit house outside a home in Phuket , prompting mixed reactions online. title: Thailand explores Moscow Metro’s formula for reliable rail services
desc: Thailand explores Moscow Metro’s formula for reliable rail services Legacy Thailand’s Ministry of Transport visited Moscow Metro yesterday, August 5, to study rail operations, digital passenger services and maintenance practices that could be adapted for the country’s railway network . Deputy Prime Minister and Transport Minister Phiphat Ratchakitprakarn led the Thai delegation during the visit, which followed the signing of a transport cooperation MOU between Thailand and Russia. Phiphat and senior transport officials also toured Maryina Roshcha station and the Aminevskoye Electric Depot to study Moscow Metro’s operational systems and exchange technical expertise. Photo via Ministry of Transport Phiphat said the discussions focused on how Moscow Metro handles large numbers of passengers while keeping services safe, reliable and cost-effective. The talks covered digital passenger services, ticketing systems, train operations and maintenance. Moscow Metro demonstrated several cashless payment options , including bank cards, QR codes, digital devices, biometric verification and Face Pay. According to the operator, around 93% of passengers use cashless payment

title: Bangkok starts work on second street food hub near Pathumwananurak Park
desc: Bangkok starts work on second street food hub near Pathumwananurak Park Legacy Construction began on the second hawker centre in Bangkok near Pathumwananurak Park in Pathumwan district, following the launch of the city’s first dedicated street food hub at Lumphini Park . The Bangkok Metropolitan Administration (BMA), led by Governor Chadchart Sittipunt, opened the first hawker centre at Lumphini Park in April as part of its policy to reorganise public footpaths, improve pedestrian access and provide affordable operating spaces for street food vendors. The Lumphini Park hawker centre is located near Gate 5 of the park, close to Exit 6 of Sala Daeng BTS Station and Exit 1 of Lumphini MRT Station. It operates daily from 5am to midnight and has become particularly popular during the early morning. The BMA relocated well-known street food vendors previously operating around Lumphini Park to the new site, where traders pay a rental fee of 60 baht per day. The facility provides about 130 stalls. Photo via Facebook/ กรุงเทพมหานคร The centre is equipped with water supply systems, drainage, grease traps, dishwashing areas and communal seating to support both vendors and customers. City

title: 百年华社共忆侨批情！泰华进出口商会举办《给阿嬷的情书》专场观影
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 8月2日下午，泰华进出口商会在曼谷 Central World 9楼 SF World Cinema第8号影厅发起专场观影活动，诚邀理事同仁偕家属共同观赏潮汕话华语剧情片《给阿嬷的情书》。作为一部以泰国华人社会为背景、以“侨批”为情感载体的现象级电影，该片于8月6日在泰国正式公映。当天该会成员及家属等近五百人齐聚一堂，共同感受这场跨越山海、守望半个多世纪的南洋往事。 中国驻泰大使馆公使衔参赞吴志武、泰国前副总理陈汉誉警上将、泰国前皇家警察总署长阿伦警上将亦莅临出席，与商会同仁共同观影，体现了中泰各界对华人文化传承的高度关注与支持。出席观影的商会成员包括理事长林俊然，永远荣誉理事长陈汉士、刘秉青、郑岳龙、林齐锐，永远名誉理事长王志民、吕木龙、陈运楼、徐光辉、陈锡源、陈绍扬，名誉理事长陈扬钦、李炎炎、徐位合以及诸位副理事长、理事同仁和青年部成员等。现场气氛温馨热烈，体现了泰华进出口商会作为百年华社的凝聚力。 《给阿嬷的情书》与泰国渊源深厚，影片聚焦海外华人远赴暹罗打拼的历史，传递的孝道、诚信与家庭纽带等文化价值，引发了泰籍华人的强烈共鸣。泰国是华侨华人安居乐业、拼搏发展的热土，数百年来，一代代华侨华人与泰国人民携手共建家园。影片中潮汕先辈赴泰打拼的历程，更是让海外潮商感同身受——泰国众多华人商会历经百年传承，先辈们皆是背井离乡，凭借勤劳肯干的品质在当地扎根立足。该片以“侨批”（昔日南洋华人寄回故乡、兼具汇款与家书功能的特殊信件）为核心线索，90%以上的细节与情节均有真实原型，生动还原了那段厚重的历史。观影结束后，现场反响热烈，与会者纷纷分享观影感悟，被影片传递的情感与精神深深打动。 理事长林俊然表示，影片所展现的“有情有义”精神，既是潮汕文化中团结互助、勤奋打拼的生动写照，也与泰华进出口商会百年来秉持的诚信立业、情系桑梓的传统一脉相承。侨批所承载的情义与坚守，正是影片最触动人心的精神内核。 永远荣誉理事长陈汉士感慨道，电影让他回忆起先辈们当年在泰国白手起家的艰辛岁月。每一封侨批背后，都是一段海外游子对家乡亲人的深深思念与责任担当，影片对历史的真实再现令人动容。 青年部主任陈丽璇在观影后真情流露，她提到自己的父亲早年在泰国经营侨批馆，从小看着父亲处理一封封来自家乡的信件和汇款，那些泛黄的纸笺在她心中就是家的温度。直到坐在银幕前，她才真正走进父亲当年的工作世界——每一封侨批背后，都是无数海外游子对故乡亲人沉甸甸的思念与责任，是穿越战火与风浪也要将钱款平安送达的承诺。她呼吁青年部成员，不要让侨批的故事只留在博物馆里，要主动去了解、去讲述、去传承，因为这不仅是家族的记忆，更是整个泰华社会共同的根与魂。 诸位副理事长及理事同仁也一致认为，影片让大家更深刻领悟到侨批文化所蕴含的信义担当与家国情怀。对于华裔青年一代而言，这不仅是一部电影，更是一堂生动的文化教

title: Life insurance poised for steady growth in H2

desc: Cambodian man allegedly stabbed to death by fellow countryman Legacy A Cambodian man was killed after being stabbed at a market in Khlong Luang, Pathum Thani, today, August 6. Police later arrested a fellow Cambodian national during a standoff in a nearby street. Officers were called to the market in Khlong Nueng subdistrict, where they found 37 year old Eu with stab wounds to his neck and right abdomen. Rescue workers provided first aid before rushing him to hospital, where he later died. Photo via Naewna Police reviewed CCTV footage and identified the attacker as the victim’s Cambodian co-worker . Investigators tracked him to Soi Thep Kunchon 15, where he had fled after the attack. Officers found the man, believed to be in his 30s or 40s, in an unstable state , walking in the middle of the road while brandishing a knife. Naewna reported that police and people in the area spent more than 30 minutes trying to persuade him to surrender, but he refused to put down the weapon. title: Chiang Rai gold robbery suspects flee to Laos with 13 million baht haul
desc: Chiang Rai gold robbery suspects flee to Laos with 13 million baht haul Legacy Two suspects fled to Laos with gold jewellery worth about 13 million baht after robbing a shop in Chiang Rai on Tuesday, August 4. Police identified one of the suspects as a Lao national. The robbery took place on Tuesday evening at a gold shop inside a shopping mall in Chiang Khong district, Chiang Rai. One suspect, dressed in a brown jacket and beige trousers, threatened staff and customers with a firearm while his accomplice, wearing a red hooded sweatshirt and long jeans, jumped over the counter and filled a bag with gold necklaces and bracelets. The pair escaped with jewellery valued at about 13 million baht before fleeing the scene on a motorcycle, investigators said. Photo via Facebook/ ศรัณยู ภัตติจารี Security camera footage later showed the suspects abandoning the motorcycle in a wooded area near the giant golden catfish sculpture on the Mekong River in Chiang Rai. Police believe they then crossed into Laos by ferry. Investigators found the motorcycle had been rented from a vehicle hire business near Bak Ferry Pier, a crossing point used by travellers heading to Huay Xai in Bokeo province, Laos

title: Hlun Solo autopsy points to heart failure, toxins not ruled out
desc: Hlun Solo autopsy points to heart failure, toxins not ruled out Legacy Thailand’s Department of Justice has found no evidence of physical assault in the preliminary autopsy of Thai YouTuber Bowornthat “Hlun Solo” Pengsuk , whose body was returned from Georgia today, August 6. Hlun’s body was found at a hotel in Tbilisi, Georgia, on July 14 after he was reported missing earlier that month . Assistant Professor Dr Worawit Waiyawut, deputy director of the Central Institute of Forensic Science, said the examination found no bruises, fractures or other signs of physical injury. No abnormalities were found in the organs, except for the heart, which will undergo further laboratory testing, including tissue and genetic analysis. Preliminary findings indicate the death was caused by cardiac and circulatory system failure, but investigators have not ruled out the possibility of toxins or chemical substances. The Ministry of Justice will request additional forensic information from authorities in Georgia , including toxicology results. Georgia has not yet recorded an official cause of death on the death certificate. Photo via Royal Thai Embassy in Ankara Hlun’s b

title: Customs seize trading cards, matcha over false import declarations
desc: Customs seize trading cards, matcha over false import declarations Legacy Thailand’s Customs Department has seized a shipment of imported trading card game products and matcha powder from Japan after discovering false customs declarations and missing import permits. The seizure was announced yesterday, August 5, after officers at Suvarnabhumi Airport Cargo Customs Office inspected the shipment and found irregularities in the import declaration. Customs said the shipment lacked the required import permits and was accompanied by false customs declarations, resulting in more than 3.2 million baht in unpaid duties. The department said the import could constitute offences under the Customs Act 2017, Food Act 1979, Export and Import of Goods Act 1979 and Plant Quarantine Act 1964. Photo via Customs Department Officials alleged the shipment was imported without the required permits and that false information had been provided to reduce import duties. The seizure also drew attention from a Japanese matcha specialty store, which commented on the Customs Department’s Facebook post, warning consumers about counterfeit products. “Thank you for sharing this information. Althou

title: 泰国外长呼吁中方出面释疑，切勿激化机场风波矛盾
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 据泰国媒体报道，8月5日，针对近日素万那普国际机场中国游客登机受阻事件引发争议，泰国副总理兼外交部长西哈萨接受采访时表示，希望中国驻泰国大使馆加强沟通、增进理解，避免相关表态进一步激化矛盾，影响两国民众感情。 西哈萨表示，此次事件主要涉及交通运输部门职责，应由交通部负责调查处理。但从外交角度来看，泰国希望每一位来泰游客都能拥有良好的旅行体验，无论是在泰停留期间还是离境时。同时，移民管理必须依法进行，在尽可能提供便利的情况下确保程序顺畅。 对于是否应加强对中国游客及相关工作人员关于泰国法律法规的宣传，西哈萨表示，这也是中国驻泰国大使的重要职责，因为类似事件已发生多次，对泰国民众情绪造成一定影响。 西哈萨透露，自己曾与中国驻泰国大使沟通过相关问题，并指出此类事件较为敏感，大使馆应积极出面说明情况、促进双方理解，而不仅仅只是维护中方利益。作为驻泰大使，其职责还包括促进泰中关系发展，增进两国人民之间的相互理解。 西哈萨强调，大使在公开表态时应充分考虑自身职责，不应进一步加剧矛盾。他表示，相信中国驻泰国大使能够理解这一点，正如泰国驻华大使同样肩负维护两国友好关系的重要责任。 （编译：jinda；审校：wan；来源：thestandard） The post 泰国外长呼吁中方出面释疑，切勿激化机场风波矛盾 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

desc: Nearly 40% of Thai consumers are dubbed "invisible", meaning they rarely engage in the digital world, according to a new survey by Media Intelligence (MI) Group.
title_cn: 调查显示泰国四成消费者「隐形」 数字参与度低
summary_cn: 根据媒体情报集团（Media Intelligence Group）最新调查，泰国约40%的消费者属于「隐形消费者」，这类人群很少在数字平台上进行互动。他们的消费行为主要发生在线下和传统渠道，对数字营销策略构成新的挑战。营销人员需要开发新策略来接触和吸引这一庞大但「隐形」的消费群体。
desc_original: Nearly 40% of Thai consumers are dubbed "invisible", meaning they rarely engage in the digital world, according to a new survey by Media Intelligence (MI) Group.

title: Master plan for the South up to board
desc: The cabinet has approved letting a southern development board draft a regional master plan, shifting the focus from the proposed Land Bridge megaproject to transport connectivity, economic development and public participation.
title_cn: 南部总体发展规划转向运输与经济发展
summary_cn: 泰国内阁批准由南部开发委员会起草地区总体发展规划。这一决定标志着泰国南部发展战略的重大调整，政府从争议不断的陆地桥巨型项目转向更务实的运输连接、经济发展和公众参与。新规划将重点关注泰南交通基础设施完善和区域经济一体化。
desc_original: The cabinet has approved letting a southern development board draft a regional master plan, shifting the focus from the proposed Land Bridge megaproject to transport connectivity, economic development and public participation.

title: 60bn gold card budget reviewed
desc: A review of 60 billion baht from the 2025 universal healthcare budget is under way, says Public Health Minister Pattana Promphat, after he questioned whether the money had been properly allocated.
title_cn: 600亿泰铢医疗保险预算启动审查
summary_cn: 泰国公共卫生部长对2025年全民医疗保健预算中的600亿泰铢资金使用情况提出质疑，已启动全面审查。这笔资金涉及泰国全民医保金卡制度的关键部分，审查结果将直接影响医疗服务覆盖范围和效率。
desc_original: A review of 60 billion baht from the 2025 universal healthcare budget is under way, says Public Health Minister Pattana Promphat, after he questioned whether the money had been properly allocated.

title: Navy rejects claims over bunker safety
desc: The Royal Thai Navy (RTN) has rejected claims that border bunkers in Chanthaburi and Trat are unsafe or poorly built, saying photographs circulated online showed unfinished construction and did not reflect the overall condition of the facilities.
title_cn: 海军回应边境防御工事安全质疑
summary_cn: 泰国皇家海军否认关于尖竹汶府和达叻府边境防御工事存在安全隐患或施工缺陷的指控。海军强调网络流传的照片仅显示施工进程中的未完成部分，不足以反映工事的整体质量和安全状况。这回应了近期网络上有关泰国边境防御能力的争议。
desc_original: The Royal Thai Navy (RTN) has rejected claims that border bunkers in Chanthaburi and Trat are unsafe or poorly built, saying photographs circulated online showed unfinished construction and did not reflect the overall condition of the facilities.

title: Why missing links are the smarter choice
desc: Academics support the development of "missing links" in the country's transport network, as these projects can deliver quick results and clearly address economic needs.
title_cn: 完善「缺失环节」项目成为基建优先选择
summary_cn: 学术界支持泰国优先开发运输网络中的「缺失环节」项目，认为相比陆地桥等大型基建项目，这类项目能更快产生经济效益、更清晰地应对现实需求。「缺失环节」项目通常涉及补齐现有网络中的薄弱环节和连接，投资效率更高。
desc_original: Academics support the development of "missing links" in the country's transport network, as these projects can deliver quick results and clearly address economic needs.

title: Rising yen set to boost Japanese tourism
desc: A stronger yen as a result of US-Japan currency interventions could incentivise more Japanese to travel overseas, especially to short-haul destinations such as Thailand, while Thai travellers should not be discouraged from visiting Japan, according to tourism operators.
title_cn: 日元升值有望吸引日本游客赴泰旅游
summary_cn: 由美日货币政策干预引起的日元升值，可能激励更多日本居民出国旅游，特别是选择泰国等近程亚洲目的地。泰国旅游业者认为这将增加日本游客入泰人数，促进区域旅游合作。同时升值的日元也不会劝阻泰国游客赴日旅游。
desc_original: A stronger yen as a result of US-Japan currency interventions could incentivise more Japanese to travel overseas, especially to short-haul destinations such as Thailand, while Thai travellers should not be discouraged from visiting Japan, according to tourism operators.

title: Office says prepared food prices expected to increase
desc: Prices of prepared food are expected to increase as certain ingredients and vegetable prices rise, according to the Trade Policy and Strategy Office (TPSO).
title_cn: 食材菜价上涨 泰国熟食价格预计跟涨
summary_cn: 泰国贸易政策战略办公室（TPSO）警示，由于食材和蔬菜价格上升，熟食价格预计也将随之上涨。这一趋势将直接影响泰国民众的日常消费成本。
desc_original: Prices of prepared food are expected to increase as certain ingredients and vegetable prices rise, according to the Trade Policy and Strategy Office (TPSO).

title: NBTC deadlock imperils several projects
desc: Turmoil at the National Broadcasting and Telecommunications Commission (NBTC) is continuing as its board meeting on Wednesday was aborted, just like last month, after four commissioners boycotted the session over the chairman's qualification status.
title_cn: 泰国通信管理机构陷入僵局 多个项目面临威胁
summary_cn: 泰国广播电信委员会（NBTC）再次陷入僵局。本周三的董事会因四名委员就主席资格问题抵制而被迫中止，这已是连续第二个月发生。委员会内部风波正威胁到多项重要项目的正常推进。
desc_original: Turmoil at the National Broadcasting and Telecommunications Commission (NBTC) is continuing as its board meeting on Wednesday was aborted, just like last month, after four commissioners boycotted the session over the chairman's qualification status.

title: Call for end to diesel export ban as refineries struggle
desc: The Federation of Thai Industries (FTI) has called on the government to relax its ban on diesel exports, arguing that months of stringent curbs on refined oil shipments, imposed to cushion the fallout from war in the Middle East, are weighing heavily on the sector.
title_cn: 炼油厂陷困境 泰国工业界呼吁解除柴油出口禁令
summary_cn: 泰国工业联盟（FTI）呼吁政府放宽柴油出口禁令。政府为应对中东冲突影响而实施数月的柴油出口管制，已对本土炼油行业造成严重压力。业界主张应该放松这些限制性措施以缓解困境。
desc_original: The Federation of Thai Industries (FTI) has called on the government to relax its ban on diesel exports, arguing that months of stringent curbs on refined oil shipments, imposed to cushion the fallout from war in the Middle East, are weighing heavily on the sector.

title: Ukraine looks ahead to post-war rebuild riches
desc: Ukraine is encouraging Thai businesses to invest in the country as bilateral relations continue to expand despite the conflict, the Ukrainian embassy said.
title_cn: 乌克兰邀泰企投资战后重建
summary_cn: 乌克兰驻泰大使馆表示，乌克兰正为战后重建做准备，邀请泰国企业投资参与重建项目。尽管冲突仍在继续，两国双边关系仍在扩大。这为泰国企业提供了新的商业机遇。
desc_original: Ukraine is encouraging Thai businesses to invest in the country as bilateral relations continue to expand despite the conflict, the Ukrainian embassy said.

title: Funding to secure Eastern Economic Corridor water supply
desc: The cabinet has approved more than 7 billion baht to strengthen water security in the Eastern Economic Corridor (EEC).
title_cn: 东部经济走廊获70亿铢水利投资
summary_cn: 泰国内阁批准投入超过70亿泰铢，用于加强东部经济走廊（EEC）的供水安全。这一重大基建投资将为该战略经济发展区提供充足稳定的水资源保障，助力区域建设发展。
desc_original: The cabinet has approved more than 7 billion baht to strengthen water security in the Eastern Economic Corridor (EEC).

title: Bankers warn deliberate defaulters
desc: The Thai Bankers' Association (TBA) has warned that deliberate loan defaulters could face legal action and may be barred from obtaining credit in the future.
title_cn: 银行家警告恶意欠款人
summary_cn: 泰国银行家协会（TBA）警告，故意拖欠贷款的人可能面临法律诉讼，并被禁止获得未来信贷，以打击恶意违约行为。
desc_original: The Thai Bankers' Association (TBA) has warned that deliberate loan defaulters could face legal action and may be barred from obtaining credit in the future.

title: Women seek help over explicit videos allegedly by policeman
desc: A group of women have sought legal help after accusing a Songkhla police officer of forcing victims to record explicit videos and allegedly selling them online, with the youngest victim aged four.
title_cn: 女性指控松卡府警察强迫拍摄不当视频
summary_cn: 一群女性寻求法律帮助，指控松卡府（Songkhla）一名警察强迫受害人录制不当视频并涉嫌在网上出售，其中最小受害人仅四岁，案情触及儿童保护和执法违纪。
desc_original: A group of women have sought legal help after accusing a Songkhla police officer of forcing victims to record explicit videos and allegedly selling them online, with the youngest victim aged four.

title: Bitkub in SEC sights over hack
desc: The Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) submitted additional evidence to police over allegations Bitkub Online concealed a 2021 digital asset hack worth 1.7 billion baht.
title_cn: 证监委调查 Bitkub 隐瞒黑客事件
summary_cn: 泰国证券交易委员会（SEC）向警方提交追加证据，指控数字资产交易平台 Bitkub Online 隐瞒了2021年价值17亿泰铢的黑客事件，涉嫌欺骗用户。
desc_original: The Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) submitted additional evidence to police over allegations Bitkub Online concealed a 2021 digital asset hack worth 1.7 billion baht.

title: Govt shows unity amid rumours
desc: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul and Pheu Thai leader Julapun Amornvivat put on a public display of unity on Tuesday, dismissing speculation the ruling coalition could fracture ahead of an expected no-confidence debate later this year.
title_cn: 政府展示团结，驳斥分裂传言
summary_cn: 总理阿努廷（Anutin Charnvirakul）与为泰党领导人朱拉蓬（Julapun Amornvivat）周二公开展示团结，驳斥执政联盟可能在今年晚些时候的不信任投票前分裂的猜测。
desc_original: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul and Pheu Thai leader Julapun Amornvivat put on a public display of unity on Tuesday, dismissing speculation the ruling coalition could fracture ahead of an expected no-confidence debate later this year.

title: Rail ties with Russia advance
desc: Thailand and Russia have pledged to strengthen railway ties after transport officials from both countries met in Moscow on Wednesday to discuss technology cooperation, skills development and research partnerships.
title_cn: 泰国与俄罗斯加强铁路合作
summary_cn: 泰国与俄罗斯承诺加强铁路联系，两国交通官员周三在莫斯科会面，讨论技术合作、人才培养和研究伙伴关系等基建发展项目。
desc_original: Thailand and Russia have pledged to strengthen railway ties after transport officials from both countries met in Moscow on Wednesday to discuss technology cooperation, skills development and research partnerships.

title: Stern test from within
desc: Less than four months after taking office, the government appears to be confronting the greatest threat to its survival -- not from an emboldened opposition, but from mounting pressures within its own ranks.
title_cn: 来自内部的严峻考验
summary_cn: 泰国政府上台还不到四个月，便面临自成立以来最严峻的生存考验。有趣的是，这种威胁非来自野心勃勃的反对派，而是来自政府内部日益增长的压力。这反映了执政联盟内部存在严重的观点分歧和权力竞争，多个部长级官员频繁发表相悖的政策主张，引发外界对政府凝聚力的担忧。
desc_original: Less than four months after taking office, the government appears to be confronting the greatest threat to its survival -- not from an emboldened opposition, but from mounting pressures within its own ranks.

title: Reformists oppose delay to board poll
desc: A social security reform group on Wednesday petitioned the Central Administrative Court to revoke the postponement of the Social Security Board election. It argued that election officials had misinterpreted an earlier court order and delayed the entire process without sufficient legal grounds.
title_cn: 改革派反对推迟社会保障董事会选举
summary_cn: 社会保障改革团体于本周三向泰国中央行政法院提交请愿书，要求撤销此前对社会保障委员会选举的延期决定。请愿者声称选举管理机构误读了法院的早期判决，在缺乏充分法律依据的情况下强行推迟了整个选举程序。这一争议涉及泰国社会保障体系的民主治理问题。
desc_original: A social security reform group on Wednesday petitioned the Central Administrative Court to revoke the postponement of the Social Security Board election. It argued that election officials had misinterpreted an earlier court order and delayed the entire process without sufficient legal grounds.

title: Home improvement spending set to stay subdued in H2
desc: SET-listed Home Product Center, the operator of HomePro, expects trading conditions to remain challenging in the second half of 2026 as rising energy costs, geopolitical tensions and cautious consumer spending continue to weigh on demand for home improvement products.
title_cn: 下半年家装消费预期继续低迷
summary_cn: HomePro连锁家装超市的运营方Home Product Center（SET上市公司）预计2026年下半年的经营环境将持续恶劣。能源价格高企、国际地缘政治紧张局势升温，加上泰国消费者愈加谨慎的购物心态，这些因素将共同继续压低家庭装修产品的需求。上半年的低迷态势预计难以扭转。
desc_original: SET-listed Home Product Center, the operator of HomePro, expects trading conditions to remain challenging in the second half of 2026 as rising energy costs, geopolitical tensions and cautious consumer spending continue to weigh on demand for home improvement products.

title: K-Asset, JPMAM target lifetime wealth
desc: Kasikorn Asset Management (K-Asset) and JP Morgan Asset Management (JPMAM) are expanding their strategic partnership with a focus on lifetime investment solutions as longer life expectancy and market volatility reshape Thai investors' financial planning.
title_cn: 开泰资管与摩根资管联手开拓终身财富规划
summary_cn: 开泰银行旗下资产管理公司K-Asset与全球投资巨头摩根资产管理（JPMAM）正在深化战略合作关系，共同推出针对终身财富规划的投资解决方案。随着泰国人口预期寿命不断延长、金融市场波动性加剧，投资者的财务规划需求也在发生深刻转变，这种长期战略性产品将迎来更大市场机遇。
desc_original: Kasikorn Asset Management (K-Asset) and JP Morgan Asset Management (JPMAM) are expanding their strategic partnership with a focus on lifetime investment solutions as longer life expectancy and market volatility reshape Thai investors' financial planning.

title: โปรดเกล้าฯ ถอดยศ 3 อดีตข้าราชการตำรวจ และ เรียกคืนเครื่องราชอิสริยาภรณ์ทุกชั้นตรา
desc: ราชกิจจานุเบกษา เผยแพร่ ประกาศ โปรดเกล้าฯ พระราชทานพระบรมราชานุญาตให้ถอดยศอดีตข้าราชการตำรวจ จำนวน 3 ราย ออกจากยศตำรวจ และ เรียกคืนเครื่องราชอิสริยาภรณ์ที่ได้รับพระราชทานทุกชั้นตรา
title_cn: 敕令撤销3名前警官职位并收回全部勋章
summary_cn: 泰国皇家公报日前公布敕令，撤销3名前警察系统高级官员的职务，并同时收回他们所获得的所有皇家勋章。这一举措表明泰国政府对警察队伍的纪律整肃力度在加大，反映了近期因监察和廉政审查引发的高层人事调整。此举将对泰国执法部门产生深远影响。
desc_original: ราชกิจจานุเบกษา เผยแพร่ ประกาศ โปรดเกล้าฯ พระราชทานพระบรมราชานุญาตให้ถอดยศอดีตข้าราชการตำรวจ จำนวน 3 ราย ออกจากยศตำรวจ และ เรียกคืนเครื่องราชอิสริยาภรณ์ที่ได้รับพระราชทานทุกชั้นตรา

title: โปรดเกล้าฯ พระราชทานเครื่องราชอิสริยาภรณ์ แก่ 8 ข้าราชบริพารในพระองค์
desc: ราชกิจจานุเบกษา เผยแพร่ ประกาศ โปรดเกล้าฯ พระราชทานเครื่องราชอิสริยาภรณ์อันเป็นที่เชิดชูยิ่ง ช้างเผือก และเครื่องราชอิสริยาภรณ์อันมีเกียรติยศยิ่งมงกุฎไทย แก่ข้าราชบริพารในพระองค์จำนวน 8 ราย
title_cn: 国王陛下敕令颁授皇家勋章表彰8位宫廷官员
summary_cn: 泰国官方公报宣布，国王陛下向8名皇室服务人员颁授皇家勋章。勋章包括「白象勋章」与「泰国皇冠荣耀勋章」两种，以表彰其长期对皇室的忠诚服务和贡献。
desc_original: ราชกิจจานุเบกษา เผยแพร่ ประกาศ โปรดเกล้าฯ พระราชทานเครื่องราชอิสริยาภรณ์อันเป็นที่เชิดชูยิ่ง ช้างเผือก และเครื่องราชอิสริยาภรณ์อันมีเกียรติยศยิ่งมงกุฎไทย แก่ข้าราชบริพารในพระองค์จำนวน 8 ราย

title: สกัดจับรถตู้ขนแรงงานต่างด้าว ซิ่งเสียหลักพุ่งขึ้นเกาะกลางถนน พบอัดคนมา 43 ชีวิต
desc: เจ้าหน้าที่สนธิกำลัง สกัดจับ "รถตู้ขนแรงงานต่างด้าว" ที่ จ.กาญจนบุรี ซิ่งหนีตำรวจจนเสียหลัก ปีนขึ้นเกาะกลางถนน รวบตัวคนขับชาวไทย และแรงงานเมียนมา พบอัดแน่นกันมา 43 ชีวิต
title_cn: 缉获走私外籍劳工货车 失控冲上路心岛 44人被查获
summary_cn: 泰国执法部队在甘烹碧府(Kanchanaburi)查缉一辆非法运载缅甸籍劳工的货车。该车试图逃避警方追捕时失控，冲上路中岛屿。警方逮捕了泰籍驾驶员并查获44名缅甸籍劳工。事件反映了人工走私问题的严重性。
desc_original: เจ้าหน้าที่สนธิกำลัง สกัดจับ "รถตู้ขนแรงงานต่างด้าว" ที่ จ.กาญจนบุรี ซิ่งหนีตำรวจจนเสียหลัก ปีนขึ้นเกาะกลางถนน รวบตัวคนขับชาวไทย และแรงงานเมียนมา พบอัดแน่นกันมา 43 ชีวิต

title: โรงงานถลุงแร่ระเบิด ที่ห้วยกระเจา คนงานเจ็บ 7 ราย ดับแล้ว 2 ศพ
desc: คืบหน้าโรงงานถลุงแร่ระเบิด ที่ห้วยกระเจา จ.กาญจนบุรี คนงานบาดเจ็บ 7 ราย ล่าสุด เสียชีวิตเพิ่ม 2 ศพ บาดเจ็บ 5 ราย
title_cn: 甘烹碧采矿厂爆炸事故致2死5伤
summary_cn: 泰国甘烹碧府淮开咋(Huai Krachao)地区的采矿冶炼工厂发生重大爆炸事故。事故已造成2名工人死亡、5人受伤。这是重大工业安全事件，事故原因正在调查中。
desc_original: คืบหน้าโรงงานถลุงแร่ระเบิด ที่ห้วยกระเจา จ.กาญจนบุรี คนงานบาดเจ็บ 7 ราย ล่าสุด เสียชีวิตเพิ่ม 2 ศพ บาดเจ็บ 5 ราย

title: “ทนายอานนท์” โพสต์เล่าชะตากรรมนักโทษ ม.112 ในระบอบสีน้ำเงิน
desc: “ทนายอานนท์” ร่อนจดหมายร่ายยาว เล่าชะตากรรมของนักโทษการเมือง ม.112 ในระบอบสีน้ำเงิน บอกมรสุมนี้มันใหญ่ถูกจับแยกแดนไม่ให้อยู่ด้วยกัน จนถูกนักโทษคดีทั่วไปทำร้ายร่างกาย
title_cn: 律师安南达揭露第112条款政治犯在军政府时期的遭遇
summary_cn: 知名人权律师安南达(Ananda)发表长篇声明，讲述第112条款(王室诽谤罪)政治犯在「蓝色制度」(军政府统治时期)的悲惨经历。政治犯遭到隔离关押，甚至遭普通刑事犯人殴打。声明强调了该时期对言论自由和人权的严重侵犯。

summary_cn: 泰国车辆登记数据发生泄露，并非黑客入侵，而是通过外泄的用户名密码进行查询，已确认约800条记录被非法查询。政府计划在30天内将国家系统升级至多层身份认证机制，以增强安全防护。

summary_cn: 泰国盘谷银行（TTB）正式启用信用评分在个人贷款和车辆抵押贷款中的应用，实施风险定价（RBP）模式。信用评级优异的客户将获得更低贷款利率，同时银行建立针对债务逃避者的管理系统。这反映泰国银行业逐步采纳国际风险定价标准的趋势。

title: Two suspects in Tak Bai police killings shot dead
desc: NARATHIWAT - Two suspects linked to the fatal shooting of two Tak Bai police officers were killed in a gunfight with security forces in this southern province on Wednesday, while authorities later apprehended another suspect believed to have helped the duo evade arrest earlier.

title: 泰国潮州会馆举办《给阿嬷的情书》专场放映，重温华侨奋斗记忆
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 8月4日，泰国潮州会馆在 CentralWorld 举办电影《给阿嬷的情书》专场放映活动，现场氛围隆重热烈。中国驻泰王国特命全权大使张建卫、泰国文化部部长萨比达、正大集团资深董事长谢国民、泰国中华总商会主席林楚钦、泰国潮州会馆主席陈运金，以及在泰华人侨领、中资机构代表、电影主创团队一同参与。活动现场同步举办侨批展，吸引众多嘉宾驻足观看，反响空前热烈。 泰国潮州会馆主席陈运金表示，今天的活动不仅有电影《给阿嬷的情书》，还有展现潮汕先贤下南洋创业历史的短片，以及侨批文化与潮汕先贤奋斗史图片展。通过这些影像和图片，可以让大家进一步了解这段珍贵的历史，也让我们更加深刻地感受到中华文化在海外传承发展的力量。他说，电影《给阿嬷的情书》讲述的是一段跨越山海、延续半个世纪的守望与深情，也唤起了旅泰华侨华人共同的记忆。许多潮汕人的父辈、祖辈曾乘坐红头船来到暹罗，在异乡经历艰辛、努力创业，逐步站稳脚跟，同时始终牵挂着家乡。这种跨越时代、跨越国界的亲情与乡情，以及潮汕人身上所体现的担当、奋斗与深情，是值得我们世代传承的精神财富。 陈运金表示，虽然身在泰国，但广大华侨华人的心始终与家乡紧紧相连。泰国潮州会馆自成立以来，长期致力于团结乡亲、服务社会、弘扬中华优秀传统文化，为泰国经济社会发展和中泰友好交流作出了积极贡献，也是广大旅泰侨胞共同的家。未来，泰国潮州会馆将继续发挥百年侨社的优势，团结在泰华侨华人，弘扬中华优秀传统文化，促进中泰两国人民之间的交流与理解，为推动中泰友好、增进两国民心相通贡献力量。 泰国文化部部长萨比达在致辞中表示，泰中两国人民因深厚的文化纽带紧密相连，泰国文化部愿积极参与并全力支持以文化为桥梁的各类交流活动，推动两国关系持续深入发展。她分享道，自己曾向中国驻泰国大使请教中国提升国际影响力的核心抓手，大使给出的答案正是“文化”。她指出，文化不仅是连接两国人民的精神纽带，更成为中国发展的新动力，而电影《给阿嬷的情书》正是文化价值的生动诠释。影片讲述了泰国华裔及海外华人在泰生活奋斗的故事，承载着他们对故土的深情与感恩，展现了中华文化与泰国本土文化融合形成的独特生活方式与身份认同。 中国驻泰王国特命全权大使张建卫在致辞中表示，影片源于真实历史，“做人要有情有义”的核心理念贯穿始终。影片中，郑木生见义勇为、勤劳奋斗，谢南枝坚守承诺、写信养家，一个个鲜活的人物，生动诠释了海外华侨华人守望相助、亲如“家己人”的深厚情谊。张建卫特别提到，泰国潮州会馆多位乡贤在影片中友情客串，这一细节正是华侨华人与电影创作团队深厚情谊的体现，也是中泰友好的生动缩影。他表示，从正大集团获得中国改革开放后首张外资企业批准证书，到如今双方携手共谋发展，中泰两国始终保持着真诚合作、共同发展的伙伴关系，这正是“中泰一家亲”在新时代的最好注解。张建卫指出，长期以来，泰国华侨华人为促进中泰友

title: Thailand approves national committee for data centre oversight
desc: Thailand approves national committee for data centre oversight Legacy The Cabinet has approved the establishment of a national committee to oversee Thailand’s data centre industry following strong interest from foreign investors . Government spokesperson Ratchada Dhanadirek announced the decision today, August 5, saying the committee would be established under a draft Prime Minister’s Office regulation proposed by Deputy Prime Minister Pakorn Nilprapunt. Photo via Thai Government According to the government, the move is intended to support Thailand’s digital economy strategy by creating clearer policies for the rapidly growing data centre sector, which has attracted significant interest from foreign investors . The committee will be chaired by a deputy prime minister appointed by the prime minister. The ministers of Digital Economy and Society, Interior, and Energy will serve as vice chairs, alongside 12 senior government officials and up to three experts appointed by the prime minister. Its responsibilities include proposing national policies, standards and operational guidelines for government agencies responsible for approving, licensing and providing services

title: Swedish woman wanted by Interpol arrested in Phuket
desc: Swedish woman wanted by Interpol arrested in Phuket Legacy A Swedish woman wanted on allegations of fraud against the public under an Interpol Red Notice was arrested in Phuket yesterday, August 4, after immigration police tracked her to the island . Police said the woman, identified only as Felicia, and more than 14 accomplices allegedly posed as employees of finance companies and banks in early 2022, making more than 163 fraudulent calls that persuaded victims to transfer money. The alleged scam caused losses exceeding 60 million baht. Photo via Phuket Info Centre Investigators located the Swedish national in Wichit, Phuket, at about 2pm yesterday before approaching and verifying her identity. Immigration records showed she entered Thailand through Ranong Customs Pier on January 31 on a tourist visa valid until March 31. She later obtained an extension from Phuket Immigration allowing her to remain in the country until August 31. Photo via Phuket Info Centre Phuket Info Centre reported that police have since revoked her permission to stay in Thailand. She has been transferred to Phuket Immigration and will be deported to Sweden in accordance with immigration procedures. The Immig

title: Everything you need to decide, and do, before relocating to Thailand in 2026
desc: Everything you need to decide, and do, before relocating to Thailand in 2026 Legacy The 60-day visa exemption is still on the books, but the shortcuts around it are closing . Land border crossings are now capped at two visa-exempt entries per calendar year, and immigration officers are actively enforcing proof of onward travel, confirmed accommodation, and a 20,000 baht cash reserve at the border. If your plan for staying in Thailand long-term was another border run, that plan no longer works. None of that changes why people want to move here. It changes how carefully you need to set it up: visa rules have tightened, the baht has strengthened against most Western currencies, a new foreign income tax rule is in its third year of enforcement, and a widely reported July 2026 safety incident in Pattaya was a reminder that “it’ll be fine” is not a relocation strategy anywhere. title: Jurassic World Bangkok roars into its first anniversary at Asiatique
desc: Jurassic World Bangkok roars into its first anniversary at Asiatique Legacy Jurassic World: The Experience at Asiatique The Riverfront Destination is marking its first anniversary in Bangkok with a month-long programme of Chao Phraya riverfront activities throughout August 2026, including fireworks, free movie screenings, and complimentary ferry tickets for visitors. The attraction, promoted as the world’s largest immersive Jurassic World experience , spans more than 6,000 square metres at Asiatique The Riverfront Destination. Over the past year, it has welcomed up to 600,000 Thai and international visitors. Visitor favourites include the Observation Deck, which recreates the feeling of stepping into the film’s world, and the Petting Zoo, where guests can take photos with baby dinosaurs, described as the youngest residents of the island. The milestone highlights the continued appeal of the Jurassic World franchise while supporting Asiatique’s position as a Chao Phraya riverside destination for lifestyle, dining, and entertainment. To thank visitors for their support, Jurassic World: The Experience will host anniversary activities throughout August 2026, beginning with a riverfront

title: Saudi transgender woman reported missing in Bangkok
desc: Saudi transgender woman reported missing in Bangkok Legacy A Saudi Arabian transgender woman has been reported missing in Bangkok, prompting the Bangkok Community Help Foundation to appeal for public assistance in locating her after all contact was lost on July 29. The foundation shared the appeal on Facebook today, August 5, asking the public to help share the post and provide any information that could help locate the missing woman . According to the foundation, Nasser Alzahrani, whose name appears on her passport and other government identification documents, arrived in Thailand on May 29 and has been staying in Bangkok on a tourist visa for more than two months. Photo via Bangkok Community Help Foundation During her stay, she had reportedly been changing Airbnb accommodations approximately every five days. Her last known location was in Khlong Toei district, Bangkok. The foundation said her last contact with friends was at 2.19pm on July 29. Since then, all communication has stopped, both of her mobile phones have been switched off, and all of her WhatsApp numbers have become unreachable. Photo via Bangkok Community Help Foundation Friends have reportedly been trying to contact

title: Lightning strike kills footballer during tournament in Narathiwat
desc: Lightning strike kills footballer during tournament in Narathiwat Legacy A footballer was killed and eight others injured after lightning struck during the Golok FA Cup 2026 semi-final at the Santipap Stadium in Su-ngai Golok district, Narathiwat , yesterday, August 4. The incident occurred during injury time as heavy rain, thunderstorms and strong winds swept across the area. Lightning struck the pitch while the match was still in progress. One of the players, 24 year old Sofwan Awae, suffered critical injuries and later died. Eight other players were also injured in the incident. Photo via FC Yala Sofwan was a former Pattani FC player who had recently signed with FC Yala . Following news of his death, FC Yala shared a message on social media expressing sympathy to his family. The club wrote: “إِنَّا لِلّهِ وَإِنَّـا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعونَ We extend our condolences to the family of our new FC Yala player, Sofwan Awae.” Football fans and social media users also expressed their condolences following the tragedy. title: 驻泰国大使张建卫出席《给阿嬤的情书》首映及泰国潮州会馆专场活动
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 8月3日和4日，驻泰国大使张建卫先后出席《给阿嬤的情书》首映及潮州会馆专场活动。泰国文化部部长萨比达、正大集团资深董事长谢国民、在泰华侨华人、中资机构代表和电影主创团队等约3000人出席。 张大使致辞表示，中泰两国地缘相近，老一代华侨华人漂洋过海到泰谋生，与泰国人民以诚相待，以心相交，和谐共处，成就“中泰一家亲”的佳话。近期，阿努廷总理访华成果丰硕，为中泰两国加强战略协作、共谋发展振兴开启了新篇章。 萨比达表示，数百年来，华人为泰国发展作出重要贡献，相信文化交流将有助于增进两国人民的了解，让泰中友谊更加紧密稳固。 （来源：中国驻泰国大使馆） The post 驻泰国大使张建卫出席《给阿嬤的情书》首映及泰国潮州会馆专场活动 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: 泰总理提3条重要路径，引领东盟走向强大未来
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 8月4日上午11点50分，泰国总理兼内政部部长阿努廷在印度尼西亚雅加达东盟秘书处（ASEC）发表了泰国对东盟未来愿景的演讲，东盟秘书处常驻代表及来自100多个国家和地区的外交官到场参与。阿努廷在演讲中提出了3条重要路径，旨在使东盟能够应对全球挑战、保持地区主导角色，并为民众创造切实成果。他强调，当今世界面临地缘政治、经济、技术和安全等相互关联的挑战，任何单一国家和地区都无法独自解决，区域挑战必须依靠区域答案。 阿努廷提出的3条重要路径如下： -第1条路径：加强区域主义 在日益分裂的世界里，东盟的团结和核心地位更加重要，协商一致和不干涉内政原则仍是重要基础，但应当灵活、适当地运用，让东盟在保持团结的同时，也能有效应对各种局势。 缅甸局势是一个明显的考验。“五点共识”是东盟处理缅甸局势的主要框架，泰国支持“适度、分阶段的重新接触”，重点是保持对话渠道、开放互动空间，并根据当地实际情况作出回应，推动具体进展。这一愿景似乎正朝着正确的方向发展，昨天，国际红十字委员会（ICRC）获准探望昂山素季，据报她身体健康，这是泰国一直希望看到的事情，同样希望将来还有更多积极的结果。 关于泰柬关系，目前双方同意恢复互信，为双边谈判开辟道路。泰国愿意与邻国开启关系新篇章，始终坚持通过和平的方式和国际法原则解决分歧，维护东盟团结和共同议程。 -第2条路径：增强抵御能力和应对波动的准备 东盟不能等危机发生后再解决，必须提前做好准备，包括加强供应链、能源和粮食安全，加快数字互联互通并提升技术能力等。同时，东盟应扩大与中等强国和全球南方国家的合作，增加选择，减少对单一来源的依赖，保持地区的战略自主。 -第3条路径：让东盟为民众带来可持续意义 东盟的成功必须用民众能感受到的结果来衡量，包括保护粮食和能源安全、应对跨境犯罪和威胁、创造就业和经济机会，以及培养年轻人技能以适应快速变化的数字经济与技术等。东盟必须加强机构和运行机制，让领导人的决策真正落到实处，惠及民众。 东盟是泰国共同创立的地区合作框架，自59年前签署《曼谷宣言》以来，它将一个曾经充满冲突的地区，转变为一个坚持规则、合作与对话的共同体。过去，泰国在东盟发展的多个阶段都发挥了重要作用，例如推动东盟自由贸易区（AFTA）、东盟地区论坛（ARF）和东盟政府间人权委员会（AICHR）的设立等。 这是泰国总理时隔17年后首次在东盟秘书处发表演讲，上一次是在2009年。阿努廷最后表示，明年东盟成立60周年将是重新确定地区方向的重要机会，泰国已准备好在关键转折点发挥积极作用，共同打造一个内部强大、团结、能应对变化、真正造福民众的东盟。泰国坚信，东盟未来是如此，这个未来也是大家共同创造的未来。 （编译：KA；来源：tna.mcot） The post 泰总理提3条重要路径，引领东盟走向强大未来 appeared first on
title_cn: 泰总理提3条重要路径，引领东盟走向强大未来
summary_cn: 泰国总理阿努廷在雅加达东盟秘书处发表演讲，阐述东盟未来愿景。他提出三条重要路径：一、加强区域主义，强调团结和核心地位，采取「分阶段重新接触」处理缅甸局势，恢复泰柬互信；二、增强抵御能力，加强供应链、能源食品安全，扩大与全球南方国家合作，保持战略自主；三、为民众创造可持续成果，包括就业机会、安全和人才培养。这是总理17年来首次在东盟秘书处演讲。
